description.value: Hao's Lamb Restaurant is a Chinese restaurant on Richmond's busy Number 3 Road corridor specializing in roasted whole lamb, lamb series dishes, and sheep offal, alongside seafood and classic hot dishes. It is part of the Hao's restaurant group, which also operates Royal Beef and Hao's Tapas Kitchen in Richmond. Online ordering is available through the group's shared platform.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at haoscatering.com confirms the restaurant name, address (4260 Number 3 Rd, Richmond, BC V6X2C2), and phone (+1 778-868-1238). The site has an online ordering system (currently showing 'closed at the moment' for ordering, consistent with off-hours) and a menu listing lamb, seafood, and vegetable dishes, but contains no evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities. The OSM record carries no relevant amenity tags beyond restaurant/cuisine.
concerns: OSM phone field is empty; phone number (+1 778-868-1238) was sourced from the website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
OSM addr:unit is '180' but the website and postal address show no unit number; website lists the address as '4260 Number 3 Rd' without a unit.
Website ordering system displayed 'We are closed at the moment. Ordering system is disabled.' at time of fetch — likely an off-hours status, not a permanent closure, but worth monitoring.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant appears to be a legitimate operating business, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. A site visit or direct contact is needed before inclusion.
